Final Studio release gate. Verified closed: G0, G1, G3, G4, S10.4 all-board review/matrix and the E2E catalogue; current entry point uses SessionBackend.Real. Earlier October5 notes about story-only serving and unresolved picking failures are historical.

Remaining requirements: G2 bd-01M3DPG3KTRQNN6HKWRHYQTT0C; application hardening bd-01M4GMY9B0WS55XNXJ32JQ27DA; S10.5 accessibility/actual macOS VoiceOver; S10.6 named-machine p95/memory qualification; S10.7 bundled-runtime macOS package with clean no-JDK example/saved-project smoke and signing/notarization decision; S10.8 independent-researcher usability (at least4of5 correctly explain comparisons, exclusions and meaning). Retain the physical macOS Retina visual check in native package acceptance; hosted functional/GTK2x evidence does not establish it.

Freeze candidate source/build/runtime and distributable, run final applicable software/visual/accessibility checks, record manual/physical receipts and known deviations, and fix qualifying failures. No headless/automated result substitutes for human or physical acceptance. S1.13 i18n and S6.7 small multiples were removed from G5 by owner decision2026-10-09; they remain post-v1. Latest landed software receipt: docs/studio/evidence/20261024-results-matrix/qualification.json. Close only when the shipped approved scope meets these obligations.
